# >>> slackmod >>>
# SlackMod 켜기 이름 — install.sh 가 관리합니다(고치려면 ~/.slackmod/config.json 을 고친 뒤 install.sh 다시 실행)
case ":$PATH:" in *":/r/bin:"*) ;; *) export PATH="/r/bin:$PATH" ;; esac
alias lead='slackmod open lead'
alias lead-stop='slackmod stop lead'
alias watch='slackmod open watch'
alias watch-stop='slackmod stop watch'
alias allbots='slackmod start all'
alias allbots-stop='slackmod stop all'
# <<< slackmod <<<
